#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
php artisan test --without-tty "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

namespace App\Modules\Events\Livewire;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LandingPreviewPayload;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class LandingPreview extends Component
{

    #[Locked]
    public int $eventId;

    protected EventService $eventService;

    public function boot(EventService $eventService): void
    {
        $this->eventService = $eventService;
    }

    public function mount(Event $event): void
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeLandingFormAccess($event, authUser());

        $this->eventId = $event->getKey();
    }

    public function render(EventActionAvailability $actionAvailability): mixed
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->getById($this->eventId)->load(['landingPage', 'speakers']);
        $landing = $event->landingPage;

        return view('events::livewire.landing-preview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'previewData' => $landing === null
                ? LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, ['template' => 'classic'])
                : LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, $landing->toArray()),
            'eventActions' => $actionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),
            'publishReady' => $this->eventService->publishReadiness($event, authUser()),
        ])
            ->extends('layouts.authenticated')
            ->section('content');
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers;

use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\RegistrantAccessUrlService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LandingPreviewPayload;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LocaleResolver;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\RegistrationFormConfigPayload;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Services\ReplayPresentationService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class PublicLandingController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $eventService,
        private readonly ReplayPresentationService $replays,
        private readonly RegistrantAccessUrlService $registrantAccessUrls,
    ) {}

    public function show(Request $request, string $eventUuid): Response
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->findPublicLandingEvent($eventUuid);

        if ($event === null) {
            abort(404);
        }

        if ($this->shouldHideCompletely($event)) {
            abort(404);
        }

        // Story 3-11 / FR106 / AC2 — set the request locale to the event's configured
        // language so public landing chrome renders in the organizer's chosen locale.
        // Per-request only: Laravel re-bootstraps locale from config on every new request,
        // so this call cannot leak to a subsequent request in the test kernel or production.
        app()->setLocale($this->resolveEventLocale($event));

        $landing = $event->landingPage;
        $previewData = $landing instanceof LandingPage
            ? $landing->previewPayload($event)
            : LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, []);
        $formConfig = $landing instanceof LandingPage
            ? $landing->registrationFormConfigPayload()
            : RegistrationFormConfigPayload::build([]);
        $shell = $this->shellFor($event);
        $registrantContext = $shell === 'landing'
            ? $this->resolveRegistrantContext($event, $request)
            : ['registration' => null, 'viewer_shell' => null, 'access_error' => null];

        $replayPresentation = $registrantContext['viewer_shell'] === 'ended'
            && $registrantContext['registration'] instanceof Registration
                ? $this->replays->forEvent($event, $registrantContext['registration'])
                : null;

        return response()->view('events::public.show', [
            'event' => $event,
            'previewData' => $previewData,
            'formConfig' => $formConfig,
            'shell' => $shell,
            'registrationOpen' => $this->registrationOpen($event, $registrantContext['registration']),
            'registrant' => $registrantContext['registration'],
            'viewerShell' => $registrantContext['viewer_shell'],
            'accessError' => $registrantContext['access_error'],
            'replayPresentation' => $replayPresentation,
        ])->header(
            'Content-Security-Policy',
            $this->replayFramePolicy(),
        );
    }

    private function shouldHideCompletely(Event $event): bool
    {
        return $event->state->isPubliclyHidden();
    }

    private function shellFor(Event $event): string
    {
        return $event->state->publicShell($event->cancelled_at !== null);
    }

    private function registrationOpen(Event $event, ?Registration $registrant): bool
    {
        return $event->cancelled_at === null
            && $event->state === EventState::PUBLISHED
            && $registrant === null;
    }

    /**
     * Story 3-11 / FR106 / AC2 + AC5 — resolve and validate the event locale.
     *
     * Returns the event's configured locale if it is in the supported set,
     * otherwise falls back to the app default. Never throws.
     */
    private function resolveEventLocale(Event $event): string
    {
        return LocaleResolver::resolve($event->default_locale);
    }

    /**
     * @return array{registration: ?Registration, viewer_shell: ?string, access_error: ?string}
     */
    private function resolveRegistrantContext(Event $event, Request $request): array
    {
        $registrationUuid = $request->query('registration');
        if (! is_string($registrationUuid) || trim($registrationUuid) === '') {
            return [
                'registration' => null,
                'viewer_shell' => null,
                'access_error' => null,
            ];
        }

        if (! $this->registrantAccessUrls->validForRequest($event, $request, $registrationUuid)) {
            return [
                'registration' => null,
                'viewer_shell' => null,
                'access_error' => __('events.public_registration.viewer.invalid_link'),
            ];
        }

        $registration = $this->eventService->findPublicRegistrant($event, $registrationUuid);

        if ($registration === null) {
            return [
                'registration' => null,
                'viewer_shell' => null,
                'access_error' => __('events.public_registration.viewer.invalid_link'),
            ];
        }

        return [
            'registration' => $registration,
            'viewer_shell' => $event->state->registrantViewerMode(),
            'access_error' => null,
        ];
    }

    private function replayFramePolicy(): string
    {
        $configured = trim((string) config(
            'services.streaming.vimeo_player_origin',
            'https://player.vimeo.com',
        ));
        $parts = parse_url($configured);
        $origin = is_array($parts)
            && ($parts['scheme'] ?? null) === 'https'
            && ($parts['host'] ?? null) === 'player.vimeo.com'
            && ! isset($parts['port'])
            && ! isset($parts['user'])
            && ! isset($parts['pass'])
            && ! isset($parts['path'])
            && ! isset($parts['query'])
            && ! isset($parts['fragment'])
                ? $configured
                : 'https://player.vimeo.com';

        return "frame-src 'self' {$origin}; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'";
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventCustomDomainScope;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\EventCustomDomain;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\URL;

final class RegistrantAccessUrlService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventCustomDomainService $customDomains,
    ) {}

    public function forRegistration(
        Event $event,
        Registration $registration,
        Carbon $expiresAt,
    ): string {
        $domain = $this->customDomains->activeDomainForEvent($event);

        if (! $domain instanceof EventCustomDomain) {
            return URL::temporarySignedRoute(
                'events.public.show',
                $expiresAt,
                [
                    'eventUuid' => $event->uuid,
                    'registration' => $registration->uuid,
                ],
            );
        }

        $host = $domain->hostname_normalized;
        $path = $domain->scope === EventCustomDomainScope::EVENT
            ? '/'
            : $this->customDomains->hubPathForEvent($domain, $event);
        $expires = $expiresAt->getTimestamp();
        $signature = $this->signature(
            $host,
            $path,
            $event->uuid,
            $registration->uuid,
            $expires,
        );

        return 'https://'.$host.$path.'?'.http_build_query([
            'event_uuid' => $event->uuid,
            'registration' => $registration->uuid,
            'intended_host' => $host,
            'expires' => $expires,
            'custom_signature' => $signature,
        ], '', '&', PHP_QUERY_RFC3986);
    }

    public function validForRequest(
        Event $event,
        Request $request,
        string $registrationUuid,
    ): bool {
        $customSignature = $request->query('custom_signature');
        $intendedHost = $request->query('intended_host');
        $eventUuid = $request->query('event_uuid');
        $expires = $request->query('expires');

        if (
            ! is_string($customSignature)
            || ! is_string($intendedHost)
            || ! is_string($eventUuid)
            || ! is_scalar($expires)
        ) {
            return $request->hasValidSignature();
        }

        $requestHost = strtolower(rtrim($request->getHost(), '.'));
        $intendedHost = strtolower(rtrim($intendedHost, '.'));
        $expires = filter_var($expires, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
        if (
            $requestHost === ''
            || ! hash_equals($requestHost, $intendedHost)
            || ! hash_equals($event->uuid, strtolower($eventUuid))
            || $expires === false
            || $expires < now()->getTimestamp()
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        $domain = $this->customDomains->activeDomainForHost($requestHost);
        if (
            ! $domain instanceof EventCustomDomain
            || (int) $domain->team_id !== (int) $event->team_id
            || (
                $domain->scope === EventCustomDomainScope::EVENT
                && (int) $domain->event_id !== (int) $event->id
            )
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        $path = $request->getPathInfo();
        $expectedPath = $domain->scope === EventCustomDomainScope::EVENT
            ? '/'
            : $this->customDomains->hubPathForEvent($domain, $event);
        if (! hash_equals($expectedPath, $path)) {
            return false;
        }

        return hash_equals(
            $this->signature(
                $requestHost,
                $path,
                $event->uuid,
                $registrationUuid,
                $expires,
            ),
            $customSignature,
        );
    }

    private function signature(
        string $host,
        string $path,
        string $eventUuid,
        string $registrationUuid,
        int $expires,
    ): string {
        $payload = implode("\n", [
            'registrant-access-v1',
            strtolower($host),
            $path,
            strtolower($eventUuid),
            strtolower($registrationUuid),
            (string) $expires,
        ]);

        return hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, (string) config('app.key'));
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Traits\PermissionTesting;
use Tests\Traits\TeamTesting;

/**
 * Base class for feature tests
 * 
 * Feature tests validate HTTP requests, routes, and full application workflows.
 * They test the application from the outside-in, simulating real user interactions.
 */
abstract class FeatureTestCase extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;
    use PermissionTesting;
    use TeamTesting;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // RefreshDatabase wipes the permissions table every test, so we reseed
        // when it's empty. The old `$permissionsSeeded` static was dead code
        // (set but never read) and misleadingly suggested per-class caching
        // that couldn't work under RefreshDatabase. Removed 2026-04-23 per
        // test-review-1-3 isolation finding.
        $this->seedPermissionsOnce();
    }
    
    /**
     * Seed permissions only once per test run to avoid redundant seeding
     */
    protected function seedPermissionsOnce(): void
    {
        // Check if permissions table is empty (RefreshDatabase clears it)
        if (\App\Models\RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shortcut: create an email-verified user. Targets the 25+ repetitions
     * of `User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()])` across
     * Epic 1 suites (test-review-1-3 Maintainability finding).
     */
    protected function verifiedUser(array $attributes = []): \App\Models\User
    {
        return \App\Models\User::factory()->create(array_merge(
            ['email_verified_at' => now()],
            $attributes,
        ));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Traits;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Team;

/**
 * Helper methods for team-related testing
 */
trait TeamTesting
{
    /**
     * Create a user with a team
     * 
     * @return array{user: User, team: Team}
     */
    protected function createUserWithTeam(): array
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $team = Team::factory()->create();
        $user->teams()->attach($team);
        $user->switchTeam($team);
        
        return ['user' => $user, 'team' => $team];
    }
    
    /**
     * Create multiple teams for a user
     * 
     * @param User $user
     * @param int $count
     * @return array<Team>
     */
    protected function createMultipleTeams(User $user, int $count = 2): array
    {
        $teams = Team::factory()->count($count)->create();
        
        foreach ($teams as $team) {
            $user->teams()->attach($team);
        }
        
        return $teams->all();
    }
    
    /**
     * Assert that a user belongs to a team
     * 
     * @param User $user
     * @param Team $team
     */
    protected function assertUserBelongsToTeam(User $user, Team $team): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue(
            $user->teams->contains($team),
            "User should belong to team: {$team->name}"
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Assert that a user does not belong to a team
     * 
     * @param User $user
     * @param Team $team
     */
    protected function assertUserDoesNotBelongToTeam(User $user, Team $team): void
    {
        $this->assertFalse(
            $user->teams->contains($team),
            "User should not belong to team: {$team->name}"
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Assert that a user's current team is the specified team
     * 
     * @param User $user
     * @param Team $team
     */
    protected function assertCurrentTeam(User $user, Team $team): void
    {
        $this->assertEquals(
            $team->id,
            $user->current_team_id,
            "User's current team should be: {$team->name}"
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Create a scenario with multiple teams and users for testing team isolation
     * 
     * @return array{teams: array, users: array}
     */
    protected function createTeamIsolationScenario(): array
    {
        $team1 = Team::factory()->create(['name' => 'Team Alpha']);
        $team2 = Team::factory()->create(['name' => 'Team Beta']);
        
        $user1 = User::factory()->create();
        $user1->teams()->attach($team1);
        $user1->switchTeam($team1);
        
        $user2 = User::factory()->create();
        $user2->teams()->attach($team2);
        $user2->switchTeam($team2);
        
        return [
            'teams' => [
                'team1' => $team1,
                'team2' => $team2,
            ],
            'users' => [
                'user1' => $user1,
                'user2' => $user2,
            ],
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Traits;

use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Constants\Permissions;
use App\Enums\PermissionResource;
use App\Registries\PermissionResourceRegistry;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Enums\PermissionAction;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Enums\PermissionScope;

trait PermissionTesting
{
    /**
     * Create a user with a specific role and permissions for a team
     */
    protected function createUserWithRoleAndPermissions(
        string $roleKey,
        array $permissions,
        Team $team,
    ): User {
        // Check if role already exists, create if not
        $role = Role::where("key", $roleKey)->first();
        if (!$role) {
            $role = Role::create([
                "name" => $roleKey,
                "key" => $roleKey,
            ]);
        }

        // Assign permissions to the role
        foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
            // Parse permission string (e.g., "tickets.viewany.team")
            $parts = explode('.', $permission);
            if (count($parts) === 3) {
                $role->permissions()->firstOrCreate([
                    'resource' => $parts[0],
                    'action' => $parts[1],
                    'scope' => $parts[2],
                ]);
            }
        }

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            "current_team_id" => $team->id,
        ]);
        
        // Attach user to team
        $user->teams()->attach($team);

        $user->assignRole($role, $team);

        return $user;
    }

    /**
     * Create a user with a system admin role (is_system_admin = true)
     */
    protected function createUserWithSystemAdminRole(
        string $roleKey,
        array $permissions,
        Team $team,
    ): User {
        // Check if role already exists, create if not
        $role = Role::where("key", $roleKey)->first();
        if (!$role) {
            $role = Role::create([
                "name" => $roleKey,
                "key" => $roleKey,
                "is_system_admin" => true, // This is the key difference
            ]);
        }

        // Assign permissions to the role
        foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
            $role->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            "current_team_id" => $team->id,
        ]);

        $user->assignRole($role, $team);

        return $user;
    }

    /**
     * Create a SuperAdmin user with cross-team permissions
     */
    protected function createSuperAdmin(Team $team): User
    {
        $permissions = [];

        // Add permissions for base PermissionResource enum cases
        foreach (PermissionResource::cases() as $resource) {
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::VIEW);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::VIEW_ANY);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::CREATE);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::UPDATE);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::DELETE);
        }

        // Also add permissions for all module-registered resources
        foreach (PermissionResourceRegistry::all() as $resource) {
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::VIEW);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::VIEW_ANY);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::CREATE);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::UPDATE);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::DELETE);
        }

        return $this->createUserWithSystemAdminRole(
            "system_admin",

<?php

namespace Tests\Traits;

use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Constants\Permissions;
use App\Enums\PermissionResource;
use App\Registries\PermissionResourceRegistry;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Enums\PermissionAction;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Enums\PermissionScope;

trait PermissionTesting
{
    /**
     * Create a user with a specific role and permissions for a team
     */
    protected function createUserWithRoleAndPermissions(
        string $roleKey,
        array $permissions,
        Team $team,
    ): User {
        // Check if role already exists, create if not
        $role = Role::where("key", $roleKey)->first();
        if (!$role) {
            $role = Role::create([
                "name" => $roleKey,
                "key" => $roleKey,
            ]);
        }

        // Assign permissions to the role
        foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
            // Parse permission string (e.g., "tickets.viewany.team")
            $parts = explode('.', $permission);
            if (count($parts) === 3) {
                $role->permissions()->firstOrCreate([
                    'resource' => $parts[0],
                    'action' => $parts[1],
                    'scope' => $parts[2],
                ]);
            }
        }

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            "current_team_id" => $team->id,
        ]);
        
        // Attach user to team
        $user->teams()->attach($team);

        $user->assignRole($role, $team);

        return $user;
    }

    /**
     * Create a user with a system admin role (is_system_admin = true)
     */
    protected function createUserWithSystemAdminRole(
        string $roleKey,
        array $permissions,
        Team $team,
    ): User {
        // Check if role already exists, create if not
        $role = Role::where("key", $roleKey)->first();
        if (!$role) {
            $role = Role::create([
                "name" => $roleKey,
                "key" => $roleKey,
                "is_system_admin" => true, // This is the key difference
            ]);
        }

        // Assign permissions to the role
        foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
            $role->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            "current_team_id" => $team->id,
        ]);

        $user->assignRole($role, $team);

        return $user;
    }

    /**
     * Create a SuperAdmin user with cross-team permissions
     */
    protected function createSuperAdmin(Team $team): User
    {
        $permissions = [];

        // Add permissions for base PermissionResource enum cases
        foreach (PermissionResource::cases() as $resource) {
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::VIEW);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::VIEW_ANY);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::CREATE);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::UPDATE);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::DELETE);
        }

        // Also add permissions for all module-registered resources
        foreach (PermissionResourceRegistry::all() as $resource) {
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::VIEW);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::VIEW_ANY);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::CREATE);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::UPDATE);
            $permissions[] = Permissions::buildGlobal($resource, PermissionAction::DELETE);
        }

        return $this->createUserWithSystemAdminRole(
            "system_admin",
            $permissions,
            $team,
        );
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Enums;

/**
 * Canonical role identifiers. Enum values are the string keys stored in
 * `roles.key` and the Jetstream `team_user.role` pivot column — they
 * MUST match the role names registered in JetstreamServiceProvider
 * (`admin`, `co-host`, `billing-admin`).
 *
 * SYSTEM_ADMIN is the platform-level super-admin and lives outside the
 * Jetstream team-role vocabulary; its value is `system_admin` to avoid
 * collision with the team "admin" role.
 */
enum UserRole: string
{
    case SYSTEM_ADMIN = 'system_admin';
    case ADMIN = 'admin';
    case BILLING_ADMIN = 'billing-admin';
    case CO_HOST = 'co-host';

    /**
     * Get all role values as array
     */
    public static function values(): array
    {
        return array_column(self::cases(), 'value');
    }

    /**
     * Get role label for UI
     */
    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::SYSTEM_ADMIN => 'System Administrator',
            self::ADMIN => 'Administrator',
            self::BILLING_ADMIN => 'Billing Admin',
            self::CO_HOST => 'Co-host',
        };
    }

    /**
     * The role a workspace creator is auto-assigned to. Jetstream team
     * owners cannot be demoted below this role.
     */
    public static function ownerDefault(): self
    {
        return self::ADMIN;
    }

    /**
     * Roles that a workspace admin may assign when inviting or editing
     * team members. Excludes SYSTEM_ADMIN (platform-scope, never granted via
     * team UI). ADMIN is a workspace role, not ownership transfer.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function assignableTeamRoleValues(): array
    {
        return [
            self::ADMIN->value,
            self::CO_HOST->value,
            self::BILLING_ADMIN->value,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Role;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Platform\Authz\Core\PermissionOrchestrator;
use Platform\Authz\Core\PermissionRegistry;

class RoleSeeder extends Seeder
{
    private const PERMISSIONS_DIR = 'database/seed-data/permissions';

    /**
     * Run the database seeds.
     */
    public function run(): void
    {
        // Get or create the system admin role (created by SuperadminSeeder)
        $systemAdminRole = Role::updateOrCreate(
            ['key' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->value],
            [
                'name' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->label(),
                'description' => 'Full system access across all teams and resources',
                'is_system_role' => true,
                'is_system_admin' => true,
            ]
        );

        // jakomeet team Administrator (Jetstream `admin` role).
        $adminRole = Role::updateOrCreate([
            'key' => UserRole::ADMIN->value,
        ], [
            'name' => UserRole::ADMIN->label(),
            'description' => 'Full access to all features within the workspace',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // jakomeet Billing Admin (Jetstream `billing-admin` role).
        $billingAdminRole = Role::updateOrCreate([
            'key' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value,
        ], [
            'name' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->label(),
            'description' => 'Manages billing, invoices, and payment methods',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // jakomeet Co-host (Jetstream `co-host` role).
        $coHostRole = Role::updateOrCreate([
            'key' => UserRole::CO_HOST->value,
        ], [
            'name' => UserRole::CO_HOST->label(),
            'description' => 'Collaborates on events without access to billing or workspace settings',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // Assign permissions to system admin (all global permissions)
        $systemAdminPermissions = PermissionRegistry::allGlobalPermissions();

        foreach ($systemAdminPermissions as $permission) {
            $systemAdminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to jakomeet team Administrator. The admin CSV is
        // primarily a platform/global matrix; tenant admins must always retain
        // the canonical team-scoped baseline even when that CSV is present.
        $adminPermissions = array_values(array_unique(array_merge(
            $this->defaultAdminPermissions(),
            $this->teamScopedPermissions($this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_admin.csv', 'Admin', ['+'])),
        )));

        foreach ($adminPermissions as $permission) {
            $adminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to Billing Admin
        $billingPermissions = $this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_client.csv', 'Billing Admin', ['true', '1', '+']);

        if (empty($billingPermissions)) {
            $billingPermissions = $this->defaultBillingPermissions();
        }

        // Filter out global permissions (billing admin is not a platform super-admin)
        $billingPermissions = $this->teamScopedPermissions($billingPermissions);

        foreach ($billingPermissions as $permission) {
            $billingAdminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to Co-host (collaborator, no billing / workspace-settings access)
        $coHostPermissions = $this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_client.csv', 'Co-Host', ['true', '1', '+']);

        if (empty($coHostPermissions)) {
            $coHostPermissions = $this->defaultCoHostPermissions();
        }

        // Filter out global permissions (co-host is not a platform super-admin)
        $coHostPermissions = $this->teamScopedPermissions($coHostPermissions);

        foreach ($coHostPermissions as $permission) {
            $coHostRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        resolve(PermissionOrchestrator::class)->flushAll();
    }

    /**
     * Return the default Admin permissions when the CSV mapping is unavailable.
     */
    private function defaultAdminPermissions(): array
    {
        return array_filter(
            PermissionRegistry::teamPermissions(),
            function ($permission) {
                // Network settings and partner services are system-wide: regular admins can only VIEW
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'network_settings.') || str_starts_with($permission, 'partner_services.')) {
                    return str_contains($permission, '.viewany.') || str_contains($permission, '.view.');
                }

                // Ticket categories: admins can only view
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'ticket_categories.')) {
                    return str_contains($permission, '.viewany.') || str_contains($permission, '.view.');
                }

                // Tickets: admins should not delete
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'tickets.delete.')) {
                    return false;
                }

                return true;
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Default permissions for billing users when CSV data is missing.
     */
    private function defaultBillingPermissions(): array
    {
        return array_filter(
            PermissionRegistry::allCrudNoDelete(),
            function ($permission) {
                // Network settings and partner services are system-wide: billing users can only VIEW
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'network_settings.') || str_starts_with($permission, 'partner_services.')) {
                    return str_contains($permission, '.viewany.') || str_contains($permission, '.view.');
                }

                return true;
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Default permissions for Co-host when CSV data is missing (read-only + events).
     */
    private function defaultCoHostPermissions(): array
    {
        return PermissionRegistry::allReadOnly();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $permissions
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function teamScopedPermissions(array $permissions): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            $permissions,
            fn (string $permission): bool => ! PermissionRegistry::isGlobalPermission($permission),
        ));
    }

    /** Pull a permission list from the CSV file for the given column (+ entries only). */
    private function permissionsFromCsv(string $fileName, string $column, array $truthyFlags): array
    {
        $csvPath = $this->permissionsFilePath($fileName);

        if (! is_readable($csvPath)) {
            return [];
        }

        $handle = fopen($csvPath, 'r');

        if ($handle === false) {
            return [];

            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // jakomeet Billing Admin (Jetstream `billing-admin` role).
        $billingAdminRole = Role::updateOrCreate([
            'key' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value,
        ], [
            'name' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->label(),
            'description' => 'Manages billing, invoices, and payment methods',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // jakomeet Co-host (Jetstream `co-host` role).
        $coHostRole = Role::updateOrCreate([
            'key' => UserRole::CO_HOST->value,
        ], [
            'name' => UserRole::CO_HOST->label(),
            'description' => 'Collaborates on events without access to billing or workspace settings',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // Assign permissions to system admin (all global permissions)
        $systemAdminPermissions = PermissionRegistry::allGlobalPermissions();

        foreach ($systemAdminPermissions as $permission) {
            $systemAdminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to jakomeet team Administrator. The admin CSV is
        // primarily a platform/global matrix; tenant admins must always retain
        // the canonical team-scoped baseline even when that CSV is present.
        $adminPermissions = array_values(array_unique(array_merge(
            $this->defaultAdminPermissions(),
            $this->teamScopedPermissions($this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_admin.csv', 'Admin', ['+'])),
        )));

        foreach ($adminPermissions as $permission) {
            $adminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to Billing Admin
        $billingPermissions = $this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_client.csv', 'Billing Admin', ['true', '1', '+']);

        if (empty($billingPermissions)) {
            $billingPermissions = $this->defaultBillingPermissions();
        }

        // Filter out global permissions (billing admin is not a platform super-admin)
        $billingPermissions = $this->teamScopedPermissions($billingPermissions);

        foreach ($billingPermissions as $permission) {
            $billingAdminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to Co-host (collaborator, no billing / workspace-settings access)
        $coHostPermissions = $this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_client.csv', 'Co-Host', ['true', '1', '+']);

        if (empty($coHostPermissions)) {
            $coHostPermissions = $this->defaultCoHostPermissions();
        }

        // Filter out global permissions (co-host is not a platform super-admin)
        $coHostPermissions = $this->teamScopedPermissions($coHostPermissions);

        foreach ($coHostPermissions as $permission) {
            $coHostRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        resolve(PermissionOrchestrator::class)->flushAll();
    }

    /**
     * Return the default Admin permissions when the CSV mapping is unavailable.
     */
    private function defaultAdminPermissions(): array
    {
        return array_filter(
            PermissionRegistry::teamPermissions(),
            function ($permission) {
                // Network settings and partner services are system-wide: regular admins can only VIEW
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'network_settings.') || str_starts_with($permission, 'partner_services.')) {
                    return str_contains($permission, '.viewany.') || str_contains($permission, '.view.');
                }

                // Ticket categories: admins can only view
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'ticket_categories.')) {
                    return str_contains($permission, '.viewany.') || str_contains($permission, '.view.');
                }

                // Tickets: admins should not delete
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'tickets.delete.')) {
                    return false;
                }

                return true;
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Default permissions for billing users when CSV data is missing.
     */
    private function defaultBillingPermissions(): array
    {
        return array_filter(
            PermissionRegistry::allCrudNoDelete(),
            function ($permission) {
                // Network settings and partner services are system-wide: billing users can only VIEW
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'network_settings.') || str_starts_with($permission, 'partner_services.')) {
                    return str_contains($permission, '.viewany.') || str_contains($permission, '.view.');
                }

                return true;
            }
        );
    }

    /**
     * Default permissions for Co-host when CSV data is missing (read-only + events).
     */
    private function defaultCoHostPermissions(): array
    {
        return PermissionRegistry::allReadOnly();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $permissions
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function teamScopedPermissions(array $permissions): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            $permissions,
            fn (string $permission): bool => ! PermissionRegistry::isGlobalPermission($permission),
        ));
    }

    /** Pull a permission list from the CSV file for the given column (+ entries only). */
    private function permissionsFromCsv(string $fileName, string $column, array $truthyFlags): array

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Role;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

/**
 * Story 1.5 Round 2 — assigns tenant capabilities to existing roles.
 *
 * Shares its logic with the `2026_04_21_000001_story_1_5_grant_tenant_capabilities`
 * migration. The migration covers production (roles already seeded); this
 * seeder covers the fresh-install / test-database path where migrations run
 * BEFORE roles exist.
 */
class Story15CapabilitySeeder extends Seeder
{
    /**
     * Role → permission grants, keyed by UserRole enum case.
     *
     * @var array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private const ROLE_PERMISSIONS = [
        // Platform super-admin — holds global variants only.
        'SYSTEM_ADMIN' => [
            'billing.manage.global',
            'billing.view.global',
            'billing.update.global',
            'billing.credit.global',
            'billing.refund.global',
            'billing.void_adjustment.global',
            'automations.manage.global',
            'automations.view.global',
            'events.view.global',
            'events.create.global',      // Story 2-1 R1 — defensive global bypass for cross-team Super Admin tooling
            'events.suspend.global',     // Story 2-6
            'events.force_end.global',   // Story 2-6
            'events.publish.global',     // Story 2-3b R1
            'events.cancel.global',      // Story 2-5 R1
            'events.backstage_key.global', // Story 5-4a — SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team key management
            'teams.update.global',
            'teams.suspend.global',
            'teams.transfer_ownership.global',
            'workspace_settings.view.global',
            'go_live.perform.global',
        ],
        // jakomeet team Administrator.
        'ADMIN' => [
            'billing.manage.team',
            'billing.view.team',
            'billing.update.team',
            'automations.manage.team',
            'automations.view.team',
            'events.view.team',
            'events.create.team',
            'events.update.team',
            'events.publish.team',     // Story 2-3b R1 — Admin only (Co-host CANNOT publish per AC5)
            'events.cancel.team',      // Story 2-5 R1 — Admin only per story 2-5
            'events.backstage_key.team', // Story 5-4a — Admin-only guest key management
            'teams.update.team',
            'workspace_settings.view.team',
            'workspace_settings.update.team',
            'go_live.perform.team',
        ],
        // jakomeet Billing Admin — billing-focused only.
        'BILLING_ADMIN' => [
            'billing.manage.team',
            'billing.view.team',
            'billing.update.team',
        ],
        // jakomeet Co-host — collaborator. Story 2-1 grants `events.create.team`
        // because Story 2.1 ACs say Admin OR Co-host may create events.
        'CO_HOST' => [
            'automations.view.team',
            'events.view.team',
            'events.create.team',
            'events.update.team',
        ],
    ];

    public function run(): void
    {
        foreach (self::ROLE_PERMISSIONS as $roleCase => $permissions) {
            $fqcn = UserRole::class."::{$roleCase}";
            if (! defined($fqcn)) {
                continue;
            }
            /** @var UserRole $enum */
            $enum = constant($fqcn);
            $role = Role::where('key', $enum->value)->first();
            if (! $role) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
                $role->assignPermission($permission);
            }
        }
    }
}

{
    protected $model = Event::class;

    public function definition(): array
    {
        $startsAt = $this->faker->dateTimeBetween('+1 day', '+60 days');
        $endsAt = (clone $startsAt)->modify('+1 hour');

        return [
            'uuid' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'team_id' => Team::factory(),
            'state' => EventState::DRAFT->value,

            // Produces a string; Eloquent's EventType cast hydrates it to an enum
            // instance on the model (both make() and create() go through the cast).
            'type' => $this->faker->randomElement(EventType::cases())->value,
            'starts_at' => $startsAt,
            'ends_at' => $endsAt,
            'timezone' => 'UTC',
            'created_by' => User::factory(),
        ];
    }

    public function withLanding(string $template = 'classic'): self
    {
        return $this->afterCreating(function (Event $event) use ($template) {
            if (!$event->landingPage()->exists()) {
                \App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage::forceCreate([
                    'event_id' => $event->id,
                    'team_id' => $event->team_id,
                    'template' => $template,
                    'primary_color' => '#8B2323',
                ]);
            }
        });
    }

    public function inState(EventState $state): self
    {
        return $this->state(fn () => ['state' => $state->value]);
    }

    public function cancelled(): self
    {
        return $this->state(fn () => [
            'cancelled_at' => now(),
            'cancel_reason' => $this->faker->sentence(),
        ]);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Scopes;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope;
use Platform\Tenancy\Contracts\TenantContextInterface;

class TeamScope implements Scope
{
    /**
     * Apply the scope to a given Eloquent query builder.
     *
     * Uses TenantContextInterface from the platform-tenancy package
     * to resolve the current tenant ID. Fails closed (WHERE 1=0)
     * when no tenant context is available.
     */
    public function apply(Builder $builder, Model $model): void
    {
        $tenantContext = app(TenantContextInterface::class);

        // System admin bypass — skip scoping entirely
        if ($tenantContext->shouldBypassTenantScope()) {
            return;
        }

        $tenantId = $tenantContext->getTenantId();

        if ($tenantId !== null) {
            $builder->where(
                $model->getTable() . '.team_id',
                $tenantId
            );
        } else {
            // Fail closed — no tenant context means no records
            $builder->whereRaw('1=0');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extend the query builder with macros.
     *
     * @param Builder $builder
     */
    public function extend(Builder $builder): void
    {
        $builder->macro("withoutTeamScope", function (Builder $builder) {
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class);
        });

        $builder->macro("forAllTeams", function (Builder $builder) {
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class);
        });

        $builder->macro("forTeam", function (Builder $builder, $team) {
            $teamId = is_object($team) ? $team->id : $team;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope;
use Platform\Tenancy\Contracts\TenantContextInterface;

class TeamScope implements Scope
{
    /**
     * Apply the scope to a given Eloquent query builder.
     *
     * Uses TenantContextInterface from the platform-tenancy package
     * to resolve the current tenant ID. Fails closed (WHERE 1=0)
     * when no tenant context is available.
     */
    public function apply(Builder $builder, Model $model): void
    {
        $tenantContext = app(TenantContextInterface::class);

        // System admin bypass — skip scoping entirely
        if ($tenantContext->shouldBypassTenantScope()) {
            return;
        }

        $tenantId = $tenantContext->getTenantId();

        if ($tenantId !== null) {
            $builder->where(
                $model->getTable() . '.team_id',
                $tenantId
            );
        } else {
            // Fail closed — no tenant context means no records
            $builder->whereRaw('1=0');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Extend the query builder with macros.
     *
     * @param Builder $builder
     */
    public function extend(Builder $builder): void
    {
        $builder->macro("withoutTeamScope", function (Builder $builder) {
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class);
        });

        $builder->macro("forAllTeams", function (Builder $builder) {
            return $builder->withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\AtddOracle;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Routing\Route as RouteDefinition;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Behavioural checks for the shareable landing-preview link.
 *
 * Everything here binds to the named routes, the persisted event state and the
 * HTTP surface only — never to class names, view paths, copy or markup.
 */
class OracleTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    private const MINT_ROUTE = 'events.landing.share';

    private const SHARE_ROUTE = 'events.public.landing-share';

    private const EDITOR_ROUTE = 'events.landing.edit';

    private const AUTHED_PREVIEW_ROUTE = 'events.landing.preview';

    private const PUBLIC_LANDING_ROUTE = 'events.public.show';

    private const REGISTRATION_STORE_ROUTE = 'events.public.registration.store';

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Assertions
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    #[Test]
    public function organiser_mints_a_link_that_lets_an_unauthenticated_visitor_read_a_draft_landing_preview(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $event = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Alpha Draft Briefing');

        $link = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);

        $this->assertIsString(
            $link,
            'The organiser holding the event-update capability could not mint a landing-preview share link '
            .'via the ['.self::MINT_ROUTE.'] route.'
        );

        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $response = $this->get($link);

        $response->assertOk();
        $this->assertGuest();
        $this->assertStringContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'The shared link did not render the landing preview of the DRAFT event.'
        );

        $this->assertSame(
            EventState::DRAFT->value,
            (string) $this->reloadEvent($event)->state->value,
            'Minting or opening a share link must not change the event state.'
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function share_link_with_altered_or_missing_signature_is_refused(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $event = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Tamper Draft Briefing');

        $link = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);
        $this->assertIsString($link, 'Could not mint a landing-preview share link to tamper with.');

        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $this->get($link)->assertOk();

        $probes = ['stripped parameters' => $this->stripQuery($link)];

        $query = $this->queryOf($link);
        $this->assertNotSame([], $query, 'The share link carries no parameters, so it cannot be time-limited.');

        $probes['injected parameter'] = $this->withQuery($link, $query + ['oracle_injected' => 'yes']);

        foreach ($query as $name => $value) {
            $probes['altered "'.$name.'" parameter'] = $this->withQuery(
                $link,
                [$name => $this->mutate((string) $value)] + $query,
            );
        }

        foreach ($probes as $description => $probe) {
            $this->assertShareRequestRefused($probe, $event, 'Share link with '.$description);
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function share_link_is_refused_once_its_lifetime_has_passed(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $event = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Expiry Draft Briefing');

        $link = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);
        $this->assertIsString($link, 'Could not mint a landing-preview share link to age out.');

        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $this->get($link)->assertOk();

        $this->travel(400)->days();

        $this->assertShareRequestRefused(
            $link,
            $event,
            'A share link opened 400 days after it was minted'
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function share_link_minted_for_one_event_does_not_expose_another_event(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $shared = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Shared Draft Briefing');
        $private = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Withheld Draft Briefing');

        $sharedLink = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $shared);
        $privateLink = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $private);
        $this->assertIsString($sharedLink, 'Could not mint a share link for the first event.');
        $this->assertIsString($privateLink, 'Could not mint a share link for the second event.');
        $this->assertNotSame(
            $this->stripQuery($sharedLink),
            $this->stripQuery($privateLink),
            'Two different events produced the same share address, so the link is not event specific.'
        );

        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $response = $this->get($sharedLink);
        $response->assertOk();
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $private->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'A share link for one event rendered content belonging to another event.'
        );

        $probed = false;

        $swapped = $this->repointToEvent($sharedLink, $shared, $private);
        if ($swapped !== null) {
            $probed = true;
            $this->assertShareRequestRefused(
                $swapped,
                $private,
                'A share link repointed at a different event'
            );
        }

        $grafted = $this->graftCredentials($privateLink, $sharedLink);
        if ($grafted !== null) {
            $probed = true;
            $this->assertShareRequestRefused(
                $grafted,
                $private,
                'A share link for another event carrying the credentials of the shared event'
            );
        }

        $this->assertTrue(
            $probed,
            'The share link exposes no parameters that identify or authorise the event, so per-event scoping '
            .'could not be exercised.'
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function actors_without_the_event_update_capability_cannot_mint_a_share_link(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $event = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Capability Draft Briefing');

        $viewer = $this->viewOnlyMember($team);
        $this->assertTrue(
            Gate::forUser($viewer)->allows('events.view.team'),
            'Fixture guard: the view-only member should hold the event-view capability.'
        );
        $this->assertFalse(
            Gate::forUser($viewer)->allows('events.update.team'),
            'Fixture guard: the view-only member must not hold the event-update capability.'
        );
        $this->assertFalse(
            Gate::forUser($viewer)->allows('events.update.global'),
            'Fixture guard: the view-only member must not hold the global event-update capability.'
        );

        $this->assertNull(
            $this->mintShareLink($viewer, $event),
            'A team member without the event-update capability was able to mint a landing-preview share link.'
        );

        [$outsider] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $this->assertNull(
            $this->mintShareLink($outsider, $event),
            'An organiser from another workspace was able to mint a share link for this event.'
        );

        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $this->assertNull(
            $this->extractShareLink($this->post($this->routeUrl(self::MINT_ROUTE, $event))),
            'An unauthenticated visitor was able to mint a landing-preview share link.'
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function shared_view_offers_no_registration_submission_and_no_authoring_control(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $event = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Read Only Draft Briefing');

        $link = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);
        $this->assertIsString($link, 'Could not mint a landing-preview share link to inspect.');

        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $html = (string) $this->get($link)->assertOk()->getContent();

        foreach ($this->formsIn($html) as $form) {
            $this->assertSame(
                'get',
                $form['method'],
                'The shared read-only view exposes a submitting form (method "'.$form['method'].'" to "'
                .$form['action'].'").'
            );
        }

        $forbidden = [
            self::REGISTRATION_STORE_ROUTE => 'a registration submission target',
            self::EDITOR_ROUTE => 'a link into the authenticated landing editor',
            self::AUTHED_PREVIEW_ROUTE => 'a link into the authenticated landing preview',
        ];

        foreach ($forbidden as $routeName => $label) {
            $hit = $this->firstTargetMatching($html, $routeName);
            $this->assertNull(
                $hit,
                'The shared read-only view exposes '.$label.' ("'.$hit.'").'
            );
        }
    }

    #[Test]
    public function opening_the_share_link_neither_authenticates_the_visitor_nor_unlocks_the_authenticated_surfaces(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $event = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Session Draft Briefing');

        $link = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);
        $this->assertIsString($link, 'Could not mint a landing-preview share link to follow.');

        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $this->get($link)->assertOk();

        $this->assertGuest('web');

        foreach ([self::EDITOR_ROUTE, self::AUTHED_PREVIEW_ROUTE] as $routeName) {
            $response = $this->get($this->routeUrl($routeName, $event));

            $this->assertFalse(
                $this->isSuccessful($response),
                'After opening a share link, the visitor reached the authenticated ['.$routeName.'] surface '
                .'(HTTP '.$response->baseResponse->getStatusCode().').'
            );
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                $event->title,
                (string) $response->getContent(),
                'After opening a share link, the authenticated ['.$routeName.'] surface rendered event content '
                .'for an unauthenticated visitor.'
            );
        }

        $this->assertGuest('web');
    }

    #[Test]
    public function sharing_does_not_make_the_draft_event_readable_on_the_permanent_public_landing_route(): void
    {
        [$organiser, $team] = $this->organiserWithTeam();
        $event = $this->draftEvent($team, $organiser, 'Oracle Invariant Draft Briefing');

        $link = $this->mintShareLink($organiser, $event);
        $this->assertIsString($link, 'Could not mint a landing-preview share link.');

        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $this->get($link)->assertOk();

        $publicUrl = $this->routeUrl(self::PUBLIC_LANDING_ROUTE, $event);
        $response = $this->get($publicUrl);

        $this->assertFalse(
            $this->isSuccessful($response),
            'The DRAFT event became readable on the permanent public landing route (HTTP '
            .$response->baseResponse->getStatusCode().').'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'The DRAFT event landing content is served on the permanent public landing route.'
        );
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Fixtures
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** @return array{0: User, 1: Team} */
    private function organiserWithTeam(): array
    {
        $organiser = User::factory()->create();
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $organiser->id]);
        $organiser->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $organiser->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return [$organiser->fresh(), $team->fresh()];
    }

    private function viewOnlyMember(Team $team): User
    {
        return $this->createUserWithRoleAndPermissions(
            'oracle-event-viewer',
            ['events.view.team'],
            $team,
        )->fresh();
    }

    private function draftEvent(Team $team, User $organiser, string $title): Event
    {
        $event = Event::factory()
            ->inState(EventState::DRAFT)
            ->for($team)
            ->create([
                'created_by' => $organiser->id,
                'title' => $title,
                'description' => $title.' — agenda summary',
            ]);

        LandingPage::factory()
            ->for($event)
            ->state([
                'team_id' => $team->id,
                'template' => 'classic',
            ])
            ->create();

        return $event;
    }

    private function reloadEvent(Event $event): Event
    {
        /** @var Event $fresh */
        $fresh = Event::query()
            ->withoutGlobalScope(\App\Scopes\TeamScope::class)
            ->findOrFail($event->getKey());

        return $fresh;
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Share-link plumbing
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private function mintShareLink(User $actor, Event $event): ?string
    {
        $response = $this->actingAs($actor)->post($this->routeUrl(self::MINT_ROUTE, $event));

        return $this->extractShareLink($response);
    }

    /**
     * Locate a link to the share route anywhere the mint endpoint may hand it
     * back: JSON payload, redirect target, flashed session data, rendered body,
     * or the page the organiser is redirected to.
     */
    private function extractShareLink(TestResponse $response): ?string
    {
        $found = $this->firstShareLinkIn($this->candidatesFrom($response));

        if ($found !== null) {
            return $found;
        }

        $location = $response->baseResponse->headers->get('Location');

        if (is_string($location) && $location !== '' && ! $this->matchesRoute($location, self::SHARE_ROUTE)) {
            return $this->firstShareLinkIn($this->candidatesFrom($this->get($location)));
        }

        return null;
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    private function candidatesFrom(TestResponse $response): array
    {
        $candidates = [];

        $location = $response->baseResponse->headers->get('Location');
        if (is_string($location) && $location !== '') {
            $candidates[] = $location;
        }

        $content = (string) $response->getContent();
        if ($content !== '') {
            $decoded = json_decode($content, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {
                $this->collectStrings($decoded, $candidates);
            }

            preg_match_all('#(?:https?://|/)[^\s"\'<>\\\\]+#i', $content, $matches);
            foreach ($matches[0] as $match) {
                $candidates[] = $match;
            }
        }

        $this->collectStrings(session()->all(), $candidates);

        return $candidates;
    }

    /** @param list<string> $candidates */
    private function firstShareLinkIn(array $candidates): ?string
    {
        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
            $url = html_entity_decode($candidate, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5);

            if ($this->matchesRoute($url, self::SHARE_ROUTE)) {
                return $url;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array-key, mixed>  $values
     * @param  list<string>  $into
     */
    private function collectStrings(array $values, array &$into): void
    {
        foreach ($values as $value) {
            if (is_string($value)) {
                $into[] = $value;

                continue;
            }

            if (is_array($value)) {
                $this->collectStrings($value, $into);
            }
        }
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Routing helpers — bound to route NAMES only
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private function namedRoute(string $name): RouteDefinition
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($name);

        $this->assertNotNull($route, 'Named route ['.$name.'] is not registered.');

        return $route;
    }

    private function routeUrl(string $name, Event $event): string
    {
        $route = $this->namedRoute($name);

        $parameters = [];
        foreach ($route->parameterNames() as $parameterName) {
            $parameters[$parameterName] = $this->parameterValue($route, $parameterName, $event);
        }

        return url()->route($name, $parameters);
    }

    private function parameterValue(RouteDefinition $route, string $parameterName, Event $event): string
    {
        $bindingField = $route->bindingFieldFor($parameterName);

        if (is_string($bindingField) && $bindingField !== '') {
            return (string) $event->getAttribute($bindingField);
        }

        $candidates = [];
        if (str_contains(strtolower($parameterName), 'uuid')) {
            $candidates[] = (string) $event->uuid;
        }
        $candidates[] = (string) $event->getRouteKey();
        $candidates[] = (string) $event->uuid;
        $candidates[] = (string) $event->getKey();

        $pattern = $route->wheres[$parameterName] ?? null;

        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
            if (! is_string($pattern) || preg_match('#^(?:'.$pattern.')$#u', $candidate) === 1) {
                return $candidate;

        }

            return false;
        }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private function queryOf(string $url): array

        parse_str($query, $parsed);

        $flat = [];
        foreach ($parsed as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value)) {

            }
        }

        return $flat;
    }

    {

    }

    {
        return $this->stripQuery($url).($query === [] ? '' : '?'.http_build_query($query));
    }

    private function mutate(string $value): string
    {
        if ($value === '') {

        }

        $last = substr($value, -1);

        return substr($value, 0, -1).($last === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a');
    }

     * Re-point a share link at a different event by swapping whichever event
     * identifier the link carries. Returns null when the link carries none.
     */
    private function repointToEvent(string $url, Event $from, Event $to): ?string
    {
        foreach ([[$from->uuid, $to->uuid], [(string) $from->getKey(), (string) $to->getKey()]] as [$needle, $replacement]) {
            if ($needle !== '' && str_contains($url, $needle)) {

     * Copy the non-identifying parameters (signature, expiry, tokens…) of one
     * share link onto another. Returns null when the two links carry the same
     * parameter values, i.e. nothing event specific was grafted.
     */
    private function graftCredentials(string $target, string $source): ?string
    {
        $targetQuery = $this->queryOf($target);
        $sourceQuery = $this->queryOf($source);

            return null;
        }

        return $this->withQuery($target, $sourceQuery + $targetQuery);
    }

    // HTML inspection
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** @return list<array{method: string, action: string}> */
    private function formsIn(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('#<form\b[^>]*>#i', $html, $matches);

        foreach ($matches[0] as $tag) {
            $method = 'get';

    }

    private function firstTargetMatching(string $html, string $routeName): ?string
    {
        preg_match_all('#\b(?:href|action|src|data-url)\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']*)["\']#i', $html, $matches);

        foreach ($matches[1] as $target) {
            $url = html_entity_decode($target, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5);

            if ($this->matchesRoute($url, $routeName)) {
                return $url;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Shared assertions
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private function assertShareRequestRefused(string $url, Event $event, string $context): void
    {
        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $response = $this->get($url);

        $this->assertFalse(
            $this->isSuccessful($response),
            $context.' was served (HTTP '.$response->baseResponse->getStatusCode().') instead of being refused.'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            $context.' rendered the landing content anyway.'
        );
    }

    private function isSuccessful(TestResponse $response): bool
    {
        $status = $response->baseResponse->getStatusCode();

        return $status >= 200 && $status < 300;
    }

            .'via the ['.self::MINT_ROUTE.'] route.'

    private function mintShareLink(User $actor, Event $event): ?string

     * back: JSON payload, redirect target, flashed session data, rendered body,
     * or the page the organiser is redirected to.

    private function extractShareLink(TestResponse $response): ?string
    {
        $found = $this->firstShareLinkIn($this->candidatesFrom($response));

        if ($found !== null) {
            return $found;
        }

        $location = $response->baseResponse->headers->get('Location');

        if (is_string($location) && $location !== '' && ! $this->matchesRoute($location, self::SHARE_ROUTE)) {

        return null;

    /** @return list<string> */
    private function candidatesFrom(TestResponse $response): array
    {
        $candidates = [];

        $location = $response->baseResponse->headers->get('Location');
        if (is_string($location) && $location !== '') {
            $candidates[] = $location;
        }

        $content = (string) $response->getContent();
        if ($content !== '') {
            $decoded = json_decode($content, true);
            if (is_array($decoded)) {

        return $candidates;

    private function firstShareLinkIn(array $candidates): ?string
    {

    /**

     * @param  list<string>  $into

    private function collectStrings(array $values, array &$into): void
    {

            if (is_string($value)) {

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private function namedRoute(string $name): RouteDefinition
    {

        $this->assertNotNull($route, 'Named route ['.$name.'] is not registered.');

        return $route;
    }

    private function routeUrl(string $name, Event $event): string
    {
        $route = $this->namedRoute($name);

        $parameters = [];
        foreach ($route->parameterNames() as $parameterName) {
            $parameters[$parameterName] = $this->parameterValue($route, $parameterName, $event);
        }

        return url()->route($name, $parameters);
    }

    private function parameterValue(RouteDefinition $route, string $parameterName, Event $event): string
    {
        $bindingField = $route->bindingFieldFor($parameterName);

        if (is_string($bindingField) && $bindingField !== '') {
            return (string) $event->getAttribute($bindingField);
        }

        $candidates = [];
        if (str_contains(strtolower($parameterName), 'uuid')) {
            $candidates[] = (string) $event->uuid;
        }
        $candidates[] = (string) $event->getRouteKey();
        $candidates[] = (string) $event->uuid;
        $candidates[] = (string) $event->getKey();

        $pattern = $route->wheres[$parameterName] ?? null;

        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
            if (! is_string($pattern) || preg_match('#^(?:'.$pattern.')$#u', $candidate) === 1) {
                return $candidate;
            }
        }

        return $candidates[0];
    }

    private function matchesRoute(string $url, string $routeName): bool
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName($routeName);

        if ($route === null) {
            return false;
        }

        $url = trim($url);

        if ($url === '' || ! preg_match('#^(?:https?://|/)#i', $url)) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            return $route->matches(Request::create($url, 'GET'), false);
        } catch (\Throwable) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // URL manipulation
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    private function queryOf(string $url): array
    {
        $query = (string) (parse_url($url, PHP_URL_QUERY) ?: '');

        $flat = [];
        foreach ($parsed as $key => $value) {
            if (is_string($value)) {
                $flat[(string) $key] = $value;
            }
        }

        return $flat;
    }

    private function stripQuery(string $url): string
    {
        return explode('?', $url, 2)[0];
    }

    /** @param array<string, string> $query */
    private function withQuery(string $url, array $query): string
    {
        return $this->stripQuery($url).($query === [] ? '' : '?'.http_build_query($query));
    }

    private function mutate(string $value): string
    {
        if ($value === '') {
            return 'x';
        }

        $last = substr($value, -1);

        return substr($value, 0, -1).($last === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a');
    }

    /**
     * Re-point a share link at a different event by swapping whichever event
     * identifier the link carries. Returns null when the link carries none.
     */
    private function repointToEvent(string $url, Event $from, Event $to): ?string
    {
        foreach ([[$from->uuid, $to->uuid], [(string) $from->getKey(), (string) $to->getKey()]] as [$needle, $replacement]) {
            if ($needle !== '' && str_contains($url, $needle)) {
                return str_replace($needle, $replacement, $url);
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Copy the non-identifying parameters (signature, expiry, tokens…) of one
     * share link onto another. Returns null when the two links carry the same
     * parameter values, i.e. nothing event specific was grafted.
     */
    private function graftCredentials(string $target, string $source): ?string
    {
        $targetQuery = $this->queryOf($target);
        $sourceQuery = $this->queryOf($source);

        if ($sourceQuery === [] || $targetQuery === $sourceQuery) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->withQuery($target, $sourceQuery + $targetQuery);
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // HTML inspection
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** @return list<array{method: string, action: string}> */
    private function formsIn(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('#<form\b[^>]*>#i', $html, $matches);

        $forms = [];

                $method = strtolower($found[1]);
            }

            if (preg_match('#\baction\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']*)["\']#i', $tag, $found) === 1) {
                $action = html_entity_decode($found[1], ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5);
            }

            $forms[] = ['method' => $method, 'action' => $action];
        }

        return $forms;
    }

    private function firstTargetMatching(string $html, string $routeName): ?string
    {
        preg_match_all('#\b(?:href|action|src|data-url)\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']*)["\']#i', $html, $matches);

        foreach ($matches[1] as $target) {
            $url = html_entity_decode($target, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5);

            if ($this->matchesRoute($url, $routeName)) {
                return $url;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Shared assertions
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private function assertShareRequestRefused(string $url, Event $event, string $context): void
    {
        $this->actingAsGuest();
        $response = $this->get($url);

        $this->assertFalse(
            $this->isSuccessful($response),
            $context.' was served (HTTP '.$response->baseResponse->getStatusCode().') instead of being refused.'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            $context.' rendered the landing content anyway.'
        );
    }

    private function isSuccessful(TestResponse $response): bool
    {
        $status = $response->baseResponse->getStatusCode();

        return $status >= 200 && $status < 300;
    }
}

        $response = $this->get($sharedLink);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $private->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'A share link for one event rendered content belonging to another event.'
        );

        $swapped = $this->repointToEvent($sharedLink, $shared, $private);
        if ($swapped !== null) {

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Fixtures
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /** @return array{0: User, 1: Team} */
